sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Habondia, also called Abundia or Abunditia, is a Germanic or Celtic goddess. Her name became the word abundance. She was an obscure earth or harvest divinity. She was found in Celtic lands but may have been Germanic. Medieval witch-hunters noted her as a particular divinity of their prey.
objective: Document Habondia, the obscure abundance and harvest goddess.
key_results: Record her names Habondia, Abundia, and Abunditia.
Describe her role as an earth or harvest divinity.
Note her mention by medieval witch-hunters and the Germanic question.
